d: Guillermo was eliminated from “Dancing with the Stars” last night, hundreds and thousand of fans were left devastated, we are less than three weeks from the midterm elections and Trump is busy posting A.I. videos wrestling tigers, he is now rethinking live-streaming an execution, he’s giving himself cognitive tests and passing with flying colors, we take a look back at the miracle run of our tiny dancer who swept a nation off it’s feet, and his partner Witney Carson stops by for one last dance.
